title: ESET PROTECT high severity detections
volume: As many as ESET's own High severity HIPS and ESET Inspect detections, plus any that name lsass.exe: on a tuned ESET console, a few a week. Each ESET detection makes one.
mdr_note: These detections are yours to work. Sophos MDR doesn't work custom detections, and a case your own case rule opens from them is Managed By Self.
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: Three custom detection rules for ESET PROTECT Cloud, on the third-party alert records the library's ESET parsers write from the ESET Connect API. They make a Sophos detection from ESET's detections of LSASS memory access, and from its High severity HIPS and ESET Inspect detections. Each rule matches sensor type ESET PROTECT only.
notes:
Setup:
- Add the library's ESET PROTECT Cloud parsers and the example bridge in bridges/eset-connect first, then run the check-your-data search to see detections arrive.

How it works:
- The parser sends ESET's HIPS, web access, suspicious activity and ESET Inspect detections to the third-party alert schema with ESET's category and severity, and the detection's name and circumstances as the summary.
- The LSASS rule takes any of those detections that names lsass, whatever its category or severity. The other two leave those out, so each ESET detection makes one detection.
- The HIPS rule takes HIPS and HIPS rule detections at ESET's High level, and the ESET Inspect rule takes correlation rule detections at High. ESET's Medium ones make none.
- ESET's detection names the technique, and the API's record doesn't carry it, so those two rules list no MITRE technique.

Tuning:
- To take ESET's Medium detections as well, change severity = 'HIGH' to severity in ('MEDIUM', 'HIGH'), and expect many more.

Testing:
- In a lab tenant on 2026-11-22, each query returned exactly the sample lines tests.json lists in Data Lake Search, and the rules run offline on the same 8 records agreed. The samples went in with their dates moved to the day before the test, so they fell inside the search's time range.
- As live rules there, each one fired on exactly its sample lines within about two minutes.
- No Sophos detector made a detection on these events.

Known gaps:
- Antivirus detections, ransomware included, go to the Antivirus schema and network attacks to NIDS, so they have no rule here.
- A detection names its device by UUID only, so its detections and cases carry the UUID, not the device name.
